CHELE RESULTS: November 2026 Chemical Engineer board exam top 10 passers
 Admin 
 Published Thursday, November 19, 2026 
 MANILA, Philippines – The November 2026 Chemical Engineers Licensure Exam (ChELE) results, including the list of top 10 passers or topnotchers, are released by the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) today, November 19, 2026, one (1) working day after the last day of examinations.
 PRC administered the Chemical Engineers Computer-based Exam on November 14, 15, and 16, 2026 in the cities of Manila, Baguio, Butuan, Cagayan de Oro, Cebu, Davao, Iloilo, Koronadal, Legazpi, Lucena, Palawan, Pampanga, Rosales, and Tuguegarao.

 Previous Examinations
 Bren Daniel Josue Ebriega of the University of the Philippines (UP) Diliman topped the May 2026 Chemical Engineers Computer-Based Licensure Examination (ChELE) with a rating of 90.80%. UP Los Baños' John Norbert Gervacio Capacio followed in second place with 88.80%.
 Abell Armamento Alcantara of Batangas State University–Alangilan emerged as the topnotcher in the November 2025 Chemical Engineers Licensure Examination (ChELE), earning a rating of 90.30%. Joseph Ronald Santos Roque of De La Salle University–Manila secured second place with 88.80%.
 For the May 2025 ChELE, Patricia Isabel Rebancos Soriano of De La Salle University–Manila led the examinees with a rating of 88.60%. Aaron Paul dela Cruz Infante of the University of the Philippines–Visayas, Iloilo City, ranked second with 88.50%.
 Meanwhile, Kenn Rovikk Estacio Logdat of UP Diliman topped the November 2024 Chemical Engineers Licensure Examination with a rating of 90.90%. Jeremie John Perigo Venteroso of the University of Mindanao–Davao City placed second with 90.50%.
